title: DevOps & Observability
description: Métricas, trazas distribuidas, logs y monitorización de sistemas de alta disponibilidad.

terms.definition: A method used to profile and monitor applications, especially those built using a microservices architecture.
terms.exampleSentence: Distributed tracing helped us pinpoint the exact latency bottleneck in our payment gateway.

terms.definition: Resistance or force opposing the desired flow of data in a software system when a consumer cannot keep up with a producer.
terms.exampleSentence: We implemented backpressure to prevent the message queue worker from running out of memory.

terms.definition: The end-to-end architecture that collects, transforms, and routes logs, metrics, and traces.
terms.exampleSentence: Our observability pipeline processes over two terabytes of telemetry data daily.
